headline: CFTC Sues Utah to Protect Regulatory Jurisdiction Over Kalshi
summary: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission filed a lawsuit against Utah to defend its exclusive federal authority over prediction markets operated by Kalshi.
why: Prediction markets face ongoing regulatory clashes between federal derivatives oversight by the CFTC and state-level sports betting or gaming authorities.

impacts.name: Prediction Markets
impacts.why: Litigation provides legal clarity on whether event contracts fall solely under federal commodities rules.
